audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits 51.6% over 500 games and the shape of the lane: Irelia owns levels 2-5, Cassiopeia owns the game once Petrifying Gaze and item scaling arrive. Chart already reflects that swing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike reference called the ultimate 'Petrify' and described it as a root.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze stuns enemies facing her and only slows enemies with their back turned — the facing rule is the entire counterplay and 'root' hides it. Cooldown 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Named it Petrifying Gaze, stated stun-if-facing / slow-if-turned, and gave the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabricated names ('Noxious Trap' for Noxious Blast, 'Twin Fang's range reset'), and wants.you[1] claimed SHE gets grounded by 'Noxious Trap zoning'.
audit.why: Grounding is Miasma (W), 24/22/20/18/16s, and it grounds YOU — Bladesurge is unavailable inside the cloud. Twin Fang is a 0.75s 700-range attack with no range reset. Noxious Blast is a 3.5s 850-range zone. Also unrecorded: Irelia's Defiant Dance reduces physical damage only, so it does nothing against Cassiopeia's magic poison.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written in; the grounding direction corrected; the W-is-physical-only interaction added at level 2.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere despite Twin Fang healing her for a percentage of damage dealt.
audit.why: missingInteractions flagged needs-antiheal; extended trades are decided by Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.corrected: Executioner's called for by name in itemization, plus in feeding and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ten misgendered fields calling Cassiopeia he/his, plus dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d pasted from tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Lint MISGENDER and COPY_PASTE_BLEED; champ-gender.js lists cassiopeia as she/her.
audit.corrected: Fixed in every field I touched; two report entries left flagged (see notes) because of the two-report-per-matchup cap.

edits.after: She kites with poison and grounds your dash — bait out Miasma, then ride the wave into her face and stun the apology.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Defiant Dance like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and 16s maxed — it grounds you, so Bladesurge does not exist inside the cloud and its downtime is your only green light. - Noxious Blast is 3.5s and Twin Fang 0.75s, so there is no poke gap. - Petrifying Gaze is 120s.

edits.before: Cassiopeia wins by landing Miasma, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Cassiopeia wins by grounding your dash with Miasma, chaining Twin Fang onto poisoned targets, and stunning your commit.

edits.before: If Cassiopeia takes first blood, tighten up: Miasma is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q resets and stay relevant through stacked windows.
edits.after: If Cassiopeia takes first blood, stop stepping past the wave before Miasma is spent — her 3.5s Noxious Blast farms you otherwise. Buy Grievous Wounds early; Twin Fang heals her back through every chip trade you land.

edits.before: Carry through the dance — the wave funds dives no cooldown can, and your R turns skirmishes into no-exit interviews.
edits.after: Carry by punishing the ungrounded window: once Miasma's 24s is spent she owns no dash, and E-stun into four stacks ends her.

edits.before: You are the front-to-back blender: Q through their line, stun the carries, and let the marks ground the peel.
edits.after: You are the front-to-back blender: Q through their line, E-stun the carries, and let R's wall slow whoever peels.

edits.before: Ahead, dance louder: crash waves into Cassiopeia's face, stun the answers, and surf resets through every river fight.
edits.after: Ahead, hold her under tower: with Miasma down she cannot escape a 600-range Bladesurge, and every recall hands you plates.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Blade of the Ruined King into Berserker's, then Wit's End/Steelcaps paths — on-hit is the language. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Blade of the Ruined King into Berserker's, then Wit's End for the MR — on-hit is the language. Executioner's early: Twin Fang heals her.

edits.before: Cassiopeia has no Twin Fang reset chain until she's stacked poison on you multiple times, so a level 3 dash-all-in before she's landed a full Noxious Trap setup punishes her hard.
edits.after: Twin Fang only hits hard into a Poisoned target, so a level 3 dash-all-in before Noxious Blast has stacked poison on you punishes her while her damage is still just 0.75s chip.

edits.before: Petrify roots you in place if you're facing her when it lands, turning her follow-up Twin Fang and Miasma into a near-guaranteed burst combo that flips fights her way.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns you if you are facing her when it lands and only slows you if your back is turned, turning her follow-up Twin Fang into a burst combo that flips fights.

edits.before: Rabadon's or Liandry's on Cassiopeia scales her poison-stack damage brutally, and by then her Petrify uptime punishes any all-in that isn't perfectly angled.
edits.after: Rabadon's or Liandry's scales her poison damage brutally, and by then her 120s Petrifying Gaze punishes any all-in you angle badly — Grievous Wounds is mandatory here.

edits.before: Her kite-and-poison-stack game gets safer with range and mana from items, but if you can close distance without eating a facing Petrify you still threaten to burst her down.
edits.after: Her kite-and-poison game gets safer with range and mana from items, but if you close the distance with your back angled away from Petrifying Gaze you still threaten to burst her down.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely a coinflip since neither of you has full kit access yet and trades come down to who lands first poke or dodges Noxious Trap — that's why this phase reads as pure skill rather than a hard favour either way. From level 2 onward though, Cassiopeia has no reset chain until she's landed multiple Twin Fangs, and her only real punish for your engage is Petrify, which she can't cast reliably while also kiting your dash. Push and all-in whenever she's out of position or has used Miasma without a follow-up — she's fragile and has no escape besides movement speed steroids.
edits.after: Level 1 is genuinely a coinflip since neither of you has full kit access yet and trades come down to who lands first poke or dodges Noxious Blast — that's why this phase reads as pure skill rather than a hard favour either way. From level 2 onward though, Twin Fang only spikes once poison is already on you, and her one real punish for your engage is Miasma's grounding, which is a 24s cooldown at rank 1 and kills Bladesurge while you stand in it. Push and all-in whenever she's out of position or has spent Miasma without a follow-up — she's fragile and has no escape besides movement speed steroids.

edits.before: Everything flips once she's 6. Petrify is a full-duration root if she lands it while you're facing her, and that root buys enough time for a Twin Fang plus poison-stack combo to burst you down hard — this is the single biggest swing point in the matchup. Approach at an angle, never walk straight at her past level 6, and bait Petrify onto a minion or ward a flank before committing. If she lands it clean, you likely lose the fight outright, so patience here matters more than raw aggression.
edits.after: Everything flips once she's 6. Petrifying Gaze stuns you for its full duration if you are facing her when it lands, and that stun buys enough time for Twin Fang on a poisoned target to burst you down — this is the single biggest swing point in the matchup. Approach at an angle with your back to her cast, never walk straight at her past level 6, and bait the 120s ultimate or ward a flank before committing. If she lands it clean you likely lose the fight outright, so patience beats raw aggression.

edits.before: Her poison-stack damage and Petrify uptime both scale with a full mana/AP build, so a well-played Cassiopeia becomes genuinely dangerous to engage even late. That said, if you can bait out Petrify safely or catch her without vision, your dash-reset kit still threatens to close the gap and burst her before her kite fully kicks in — this stays close and punish-dependent rather than a clean win for either side.
edits.after: Her poison damage and Petrifying Gaze uptime both scale with a full mana/AP build, so a well-played Cassiopeia is genuinely dangerous to engage even late. That said, if you bait the 80s ultimate safely or catch her without vision, your dash-reset kit still closes the gap and bursts her — carry Grievous Wounds, because Twin Fang heals her out of any trade you leave unfinished, and keep your back to her cast angle so a landed Gaze only slows.
